title: DTP3 immunization, SDG regions compared, by wealth
headline: In 85 of 107 countries, DTP3 coverage was lower among the poorest fifth than the richest
subtitle: Percentage of surviving infants who received three doses of diphtheria, pertussis and tetanus vaccine
years: Latest surveys with both groups, 1996 to 2020; median gap 9.5 points.
data_line: Data: WHO Global Health Observatory via UN System Data Commons, indicator IMM_COV_SH, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: In 85 of 107 countries, DTP3 coverage was lower among the poorest fifth than the richest. Latest surveys with both groups, 1996 to 2020; median gap 9.5 points. Gap between the poorest fifth and the richest fifth in 107 countries, ranked; 85 with the poorest fifth lower, 22 with the richest fifth lower.
method: Method: gap within each country's latest survey with both groups.
question: Where have you seen the gap in DTP3 coverage between the poorest fifth and the richest fifth close, and how was it measured?
